Is there any chance we can do a short phone interview while I sort this out, or move to a recorded coding task? Happy to do whatever works.

I'm reachable at +1 (415) 555-0192.

Hi Carlos — thanks for the heads up and sorry you're dealing with that.

Quick plan: we're happy to convert the slot into a 20–30 minute phone screen now (9:30) so you still get some interviewer time, and then — if the panel wants deeper signal — we can send a short recorded coding exercise you can complete from wherever you are. Does 9:35 for a phone call work? If you prefer the recorded exercise first, say so and we'll pivot.

I've looped in Karthik (hiring manager) and Marissa (recruiting ops) to confirm availability and reimbursement for any taxi/ride charges you incurred.

If security will let you wait in the lobby for 10–15 minutes, we can try to start the call a few minutes late; otherwise proceed with the call from your phone.

- For the taxi charge: we can reimburse reasonable rideshare/taxi costs up to $75. Please reply to this email with a photo of your receipt (or an emailed receipt) and I will initiate the expense. Attached is the short reimbursement form if you want to pre-fill it.
